drums.description: Afrobeats track featuring a prominent syncopated log drum bassline and rhythmic shaker patterns, A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, muted melodic riff, The percussion consists of a crisp snare on the offbeats and a steady kick drum following a 3-3-2 rhythmic pattern, A bright, staccato synth pluck provides melodic accents throughout the arrangement, The track maintains a consistent groove with minimal harmonic shifts, focusing on the interplay between the percussive bass and the guitar melody, Tempo is 112 BPM in the key of G minor Publish

bass.description: Mid-tempo G-Funk and West Coast Hip Hop track at 95 BPM in the key of C minor, A deep, melodic Moog-style synth bass plays a syncopated, groovy line with frequent portamento slides, The drum kit features a crisp, dry snare on beats 2 and 4, a heavy kick drum following the bass pattern, and consistent 16th-note closed hi-hats, A high-pitched, monophonic sine wave lead synth performs a characteristic 'whistle' melody with heavy vibrato, Occasional rhythmic orchestral hits and a muted, wah-filtered electric guitar provide harmonic stabs on the off-beats, The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the sliding bass and the piercing lead synth Publish
